description:
Takes one agenda out of the BriefMe account to free a slot. The agenda is not deleted now:
its share link keeps working for 7 more days and then it expires like any anonymous agenda.

The release is final — a released agenda cannot be returned to the account and list_agendas
no longer shows it — so it fits an agenda the user has explicitly chosen to drop.

share_token.description: The share_token of one of this account's agendas, from list_agendas or create_agenda.

name: release_agenda

blocks.description: The blocks in the order they run.

share_url.description: The read-only agenda with the live timer; safe to give to attendees.

title: Remove an agenda from the account
